items.summary: Sony 推出 PS5 系統軟件 26.07-14.20.00，官方說明只寫改善部分畫面嘅訊息同可用性；Push Square／GameSpot 報道同期 jailbreak 活躍，外界猜測或含未公開保安修補，但官方未確認。
items.note: Official patch notes are certain; security/jailbreak motive is media speculation (GameSpot). Push Square 'Yesterday 10am' ≈ Oct 21 local.
items.imageAlt: PlayStation 5 console

items.title: Once Human free Isles of Abyss expansion launches on PS5 October 22
items.summary: NetEase 喺 PlayStation Blog 預告免費大型擴充 Isles of Abyss 於 10 月 22 日登陸 PS5：新增五個海洋區域、可自建海上堡壘船艦，以及對抗「The Sunken Lord」；支援 DualSense 觸覺同自適應扳机。
items.note: Blog dated Oct 21; expansion day is Oct 22 (blog also notes Oct 21 in one parenthetical).
items.imageAlt: Once Human Isles of Abyss ocean expansion key art

items.title: PlayStation Store Planet of the Deals sale live through November 4
items.summary: PlayStation Blog 公布 Planet of the Deals 優惠已於 10 月 21 日開跑，至 11 月 4 日結束；數百款 PS5／PS4 遊戲折扣，PS Plus 會員部分商品另有額外減價，實際價錢同選書因地區而異。
items.note: Promo window Wed Oct 21 00:00 PDT through Wed Nov 4 23:59 PDT per PS Blog; publishedAt approximate for same-day HKT coverage.
items.imageAlt: PlayStation Store Planet of the Deals promotion artwork

items.title: Xbox Insiders can buy Cloud Playtime packs without Game Pass
items.summary: Xbox Wire 宣布 Insider 可由今日起試用唔使 Game Pass 嘅 Cloud Playtime：10 小時 US$3.99、25 小時 $7.99、50 小時 $11.99，無廣告串流；計劃 11 月更廣泛推出，另有附廣告免費雲端試玩。
items.note: Pricing/markets vary; Insider preview before broader November rollout per Xbox Wire.
items.imageAlt: Xbox Wire cloud gaming bootup graphic

items.title: A Game About Digging a Hole Together headed to Xbox and Game Pass December 4
items.summary: ID@Xbox 展示會公布挖沙續作《A Game About Digging a Hole Together》將於 12 月 4 日登陸 Xbox Series X|S、PC，並同日加入 Game Pass；可與朋友合作挖洞、收集資源同尋寶。
items.note: World premiere from Oct 20 showcase; HKT morning Oct 21.
items.imageAlt: ID@Xbox x IGN Showcase branding

items.title: The Wolf Among Us Remastered launches digitally October 29 on Xbox
items.summary: Xbox Wire 於 ID@Xbox 回顧確認 Telltale《The Wolf Among Us Remastered》10 月 29 日數位登陸 Xbox Series／Xbox One：強化畫面同音效、全新 Noir Mode，並還原可玩刪減場景。
items.note: Same showcase recap as Shrek 2; Zero Parades / Critical Reflex already in Oct 21 batch—skipped those.
items.imageAlt: ID@Xbox x IGN Showcase branding

items.title: Shrek 2 Remastered dated November 10 for Xbox Series X|S
items.summary: ID@Xbox x IGN Showcase 確認 Aspyr 嘅《Shrek 2 Remastered》於 11 月 10 日登陸 Xbox Series X|S，改善畫面並加入 Photo Mode／Cheat Mode，支援最多四人合作；Game Pass 會員預購最高可減 20%。
items.note: Xbox Wire dated Oct 20 US; Pure Xbox date-update Tue Oct 20 18:45 UK → morning Oct 21 HKT. imageUrl from Pure Xbox companion coverage of same date.
items.imageAlt: Shrek 2 Remastered key art

items.title: EA shuts down BioWare, cancels early Mass Effect project amid ~400 job cuts
items.summary: BioWare 官方同 The Verge 確認工作室關閉，早期 Mass Effect 新作停止開發；Bloomberg／Variety 指 EA 裁約 400 人（約 3%），其中 BioWare 約 50 人，並關閉 Edmonton 辦公室。
items.note: Verge Oct 21 5:19 PM UTC → 01:19 HKT Oct 22. Primary studio statement also at blog.bioware.com/2026/10/21/bioware-update/. Job counts via Bloomberg cited by Verge/Variety.
items.imageAlt: Electronic Arts branding related to BioWare closure coverage

items.title: EA says Respawn and DICE will collaborate on a future shooter project
items.summary: EA 公開備忘錄指繼《Battlefield 6》後，會集結 Respawn 同 DICE 合作「未來專案」並持續加碼 Apex；Variety 引述多方消息指即《Star Wars: Battlefront 3》，但 EA 正文未點名。
items.note: NEW Oct 21 confirmation angle vs Oct 20 'Battlefront3 talks' skip: EA now publicly states Respawn+DICE collab; Battlefront 3 naming is Variety sources, not EA text. Variety 10:05am PT Oct 21 → 01:05 HKT Oct 22.
items.imageAlt: Electronic Arts logo

items.title: EA Sports confirms Fight Night boxing series is returning after 15 years
items.summary: TheGamer／EA 內部備忘錄確認沉寂自 2011《Fight Night Champion》嘅拳擊系列將回歸，並已開設 EA Sports Fight Night 社交帳號；EA 稱處於前期製作，尚未公布平台同檔期。
items.note: Series return confirmed; platforms/date/developer unnamed. TheGamer Oct 21 2:16 AM EDT → 14:16 HKT. Corroborated in ea.com/news/building-eas-next-chapter.
items.imageAlt: EA Sports Fight Night teaser with boxing gloves

items.title: Don't Nod opens French safeguard proceedings; up to 85 jobs at risk
items.summary: Life is Strange 開發商 Don't Nod 獲巴黎商業法院批准進入 safeguard（類似債務凍結重整）；觀察期約 6–18 個月，法國重組或影響最多 85 個職位，Montreal 工作室不受影響。H1 現金約 €9.9M，Aphelion 銷售低於預期。
items.note: PC Gamer published 20 Oct 2026; Hitmarker says court granted Oct 20 (Warp Pipes digest said Oct 19—used Hitmarker/Vertical Slice Oct 20). Window includes Oct 20 evening HKT.
items.imageAlt: Don't Nod studio related artwork
